algorithm: DPI-Net (graph neural network particle-dynamics world model) + sampling-based receding-horizon MPC
hand: PSYONIC Ability Hand (6-DoF) and Robot Era XHand (12-DoF) for real-world deployment; trained across 6 simulated hands (Ability, Allegro, XHand, Leap, Shadow, forearm-less Shadow variant) for the embodiment-scaling study
sim: SAPIEN (rigid-body Object Pushing data) and Rewarped (differentiable multiphysics, deformable Plasticine Reshaping data)
headline_metric: real-robot success rate on Plasticine Reshaping (4 target letters x 5 trials = 20 trials per hand per condition), plus CD/EMD
headline_value: Ability Hand: co-train (human+6 sim hands) 18/20 vs human-only 10/20; XHand: co-train 17/20 vs human-only 9/20 (Table I)
human_data: real human hand data via multi-view reconstruction (POEM-v2, no exoskeleton/glove); 30 minutes each for ThumbPinch, FingersPinch, PalmPress (90 minutes total), used in a 1:1 sim:human co-training mix
note_gaps: No single grand-total sim-trajectory count is given (100 random-action trajectories per hand per task across 6 hands, but not summed); hand_dof is not a single value since 6 morphologically different hands (6-24 DoF) are trained on and 2 different real hands are deployed.
